class.name: GameplayRelevancyObject
class.brief_description: Transport-independent relevancy and scheduling descriptor for a replicated object.
class.description: Describes how [GameplayReplicationGraph] finds and schedules one object. Policies are mutually exclusive: always wins by being its own policy, owner-only and team-only require their exact server-owned identity, owner-or-team accepts either, and distance performs exact radius filtering after spatial candidate lookup.

members.member: Exact radius for [constant POLICY_DISTANCE]. It must not exceed the graph's [member GameplayReplicationGraph.max_spatial_distance].
Scheduling estimate charged against a connection budget when this object is selected.
Stable positive ID matching the object registered with [GameplayMultiplayerReplication].
Server-recorded gameplay owner. This does not change Godot multiplayer authority.
The single deterministic relevancy rule for this object.
Authoritative object position used by distance policy and the spatial grid.
Base scheduling priority from 0 through 1000. Each budget miss adds starvation credit, so a feasible lower-priority object eventually runs.
Server-assigned object team. Zero does not match a connection team.
Minimum time between successful scheduling passes for the same connection. Zero allows every pass.

constants.constant: Uses the spatial grid for candidates, then checks the exact configured radius.
Relevant only to the server-recorded owner peer.
Relevant only when nonzero server-assigned team IDs match.
Relevant when either the owner peer or a nonzero team matches.
Relevant to every registered connection view.
